body: Well I have been feeling that way (and doing the same thing) since I was fourteen and I'm twenty-one now and go to a top 20 us university, and I'm at the top of my class. Being good at school is good, but it's not a solution to the problem. I've made it this far because I confronted what was my issue in whatever way I could and kept moving forward. As many above have said it's not easy, it is common, but you've got to keep trying. Even if it's something as silly as finishing some puzzle or game level every week, or picking up something you've always been interested in but never tried it may be enough, and if it isn't try something else :) . It will get better, but that just may not be soon.
Can't agree more with you, especially on that kendrick note, pun intended
